form:FormGroup.helpText: Whether a redirect response (3xx) is followed to the address it gives. Some endpoints redirect in order to authenticate or to move to a new address; without this, the request sees the redirect itself rather than what it asked for. Redirects to cloud metadata addresses are always refused. Default: on

Whether cookies the server sets are kept and sent back with later requests on the same connection pool. Only needed for servers that track a session with a cookie, e.g. some load balancers. Default: off

form:FormGroup.label: User Agent
form:FormGroup.helpText: The User-Agent header sent with every request, which some servers and proxies use to identify or allow the client. Leave empty for the HTTP client's own default. Not used by Git repositories, which send Git's own.

form:FormGroup.label: Headers
form:FormGroup.helpText: HTTP headers sent with every request, e.g. 'anthropic-version' = '2023-06-01' for Anthropic's OpenAI-compatible endpoint, or a header a gateway needs to route the request. Rows with no name are ignored. Headers set for authentication (e.g. an API key or token) take precedence over these, as do headers the request sets itself. Do not put secrets here: values are stored in the document as plain text, so use a credential instead.

form:FormGroup.label: Timeout
form:FormGroup.helpText: How long to wait for the server to send data once a request has been sent: the response, or the next part of a response that is streamed. AI models can take minutes to answer, so allow for that. Zero means wait for ever. Default: 3 minutes

form:FormGroup.label: Connection Timeout
form:FormGroup.helpText: How long to wait for a new connection to the server to be made, including the TLS handshake. A server that cannot be reached fails after this long. Zero means wait for ever. Default: 3 minutes

form:FormGroup.label: Connection Request Timeout
form:FormGroup.helpText: How long a request waits for a free connection from the pool when all connections (see Limits) are in use. Zero means wait for ever. Default: 3 minutes

form:FormGroup.label: Time To Live
form:FormGroup.helpText: The longest a connection is reused for, however busy it is, before it is closed and a new one made. This lets the client pick up changes such as a server's address moving behind a load balancer. Default: 1 hour

form:FormGroup.label: Keep Alive
form:FormGroup.helpText: How long an idle connection is kept open for the next request, when the server does not say. Zero closes each connection after its request and response, so every request makes a new connection. Default: 0

form:FormGroup.label: Validate After Inactivity Period
form:FormGroup.helpText: How long a connection may sit idle in the pool before it is checked to still be open before it is reused. Checking avoids a request failing on a connection the server has closed, at the cost of a little time. Zero checks every time a connection is reused. Default: 0

form:FormGroup.label: Max Connections
form:FormGroup.helpText: The most connections that may be open at once, to all servers together. Requests beyond this wait for a free connection (see Connection Request Timeout). Default: 1024

form:FormGroup.label: Max Connections Per Route
form:FormGroup.helpText: The most connections that may be open at once to any one server. Lower this to avoid overloading a server that cannot take many requests at a time. Default: 1024

form:FormGroup.label: Retries
form:FormGroup.helpText: How many more times a request is tried, a second apart, after a connection problem (e.g. the connection was reset) or when the server answers 429 Too Many Requests or 503 Service Unavailable. Only requests that are safe to repeat are retried. Default: 0
